'A third or more' holds for Chivese (HbA1c misses about 42%) and Baye (FPG misses 44% or more; the abstract's 44.3% sensitivity and '44.4% missed' do not add up, so quote one of them, not both), and for FPG in Kasujja (about 37%). Kasujja's HbA1c sensitivity of 69.8% means about 30% missed, just under a third, with a wide interval. Baye reports FPG only, not HbA1c. OpenAlex lists Chivese as 2021, not 2022. 'The 2-hour OGTT is the most sensitive test' is true by construction in these studies (the OGTT is the reference standard); none of the passages I read states it as a finding.
